notes: Engines wear by how hard they work: takeoff thrust costs more than cruise, FLEX less than TOGA. Each engine now has fan, compressor, combustor, vane and turbine parts.
Each TOGA takeoff takes EGT margin off an engine, a FLEX takeoff much less, and a worn HP turbine takes more.
Snow and rain count as icing. Flying through icing with the wing or an engine anti-ice off wears slats, flaps and the engine; an engine run that way needs a fan ice inspection.
Timed checks and part jobs under realistic maintenance times finish while TechLog is closed, and the history shows when they really finished.
A landing in rain or snow wears brakes and tyres 15 % more; the Status page engine cards are redrawn.
